# Spike sorting

See the [spike sorting presentation slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1jj7XMH8CuXqjq5vNjO14AGM4GznmV5qtFeaZXr2lRQ8/edit?usp=sharing) for the accompanying theory.

For the coding section we will use the: `notebooks/spike-sorting-coding.ipynb`. 

This is a Jupyter notebook file, and can be run in most development environments 
(e.g. [VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/datascience/jupyter-notebooks)). 
Alternatively, [Jupyter Lab](https://jupyterlab.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) can be used
to run notebooks in the browser or desktop interactively.
